|game_text='''0 side — Hidden Base'''

Deploy Rendezvous Point. Place a planet system (with a parsec number from 1 to 8) from Reserve Deck face down on your side of table (not in play); that card indicates the planet where your "Hidden Base" is located. While this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy one system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Opponent loses no more than 1 Force from each of your Force drains at systems and sectors. Flip this card any time after you have deployed five battleground systems and your "Hidden Base" system.

'''7 side — Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers'''

While this side up, to draw a card from Force Pile, opponent must first use 1 Force. For each battleground system you control, you may cancel one opponent's Force drain (limit twice per turn). You may not deploy any systems. At each system opponent occupies during any deploy phase, opponent may 'probe' there by placing one card from hand face down beneath that system. Place out of play if "Hidden Base" system is 'probed;' Dark Side places 'probe' cards in Used Pile (and may retrieve 1 Force for each Probe Droid used to 'probe').
|printings={{Card versions/Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (Special Edition)}}
|notes=* Decipher published this errata as text in the [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]] (29 January 2002). The main image is that entry. Printed face: [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]]. Side-by-side faces: [[Errata]].
* The Glossary Supplement gives both sides: (front) the 0 side, Hidden Base, and (back) the 7 side, Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers. A ruling paragraph that follows the entry is not cropped.
* No black-bordered card prints exactly these words: on the 0 side the Players Committee's D-E1 card ([[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (PC 2024 D-E1 card)]]) says “from outside your deck” where Decipher says “from Reserve Deck”; its 7 side is Decipher's words.
